goal_summary: Workflow authors compare a saved revision against the current editor on one read-only graph and get restore checked by a no-write validate endpoint, so a broken restore is seen before Save.

roles-and-permissions.reason: R-16 covers WRITE ability and project access; localhost has one account so role cases run on preview

spend-and-budget-attribution.reason: no spend or budget path is touched by the diff

persistence-across-reload.reason: R-12 stored workflow unchanged until Save

enterprise-vs-opensource-licensing.reason: no licence-gated feature in the diff

data-isolation-under-parallel-run.reason: tests must create their own workflow; validate must not write

failure-and-error-paths.reason: R-19, R-20 invalid YAML and invalid config paths

open_questions.question: Which two revisions does the visual diff compare?

source_says.quote: canvas = selected history entry, baseline = current editor YAML

readings.reading: The selected saved revision against the current editor buffer, which may hold unsaved edits.
readings.if_chosen: Then-steps compare the selected revision with the editor text; an unsaved-edit case is written and AC8 is read as selected vs current.

readings.reading: Two saved revisions chosen by the user.
readings.if_chosen: The code behavior is reported as an APP_BUG proposal and the compare cases are held until a two-revision picker exists.

open_questions.question: Must a removed node appear at exactly its former coordinates?

source_says.quote: Removed nodes are displayed at their former position
diff layout reuses the Beautify mechanism so positions need not match the real restoration state
source_says.where: developer comment on TP1-14482 (per S1 manifest conflicts)

readings.reading: Former position means the node keeps the coordinates saved in the baseline.
readings.if_chosen: A coordinate assertion on the removed node is written; the Beautify re-layout is reported as a defect.

readings.reading: Former position means its place in the graph topology; layout is recomputed.
readings.if_chosen: Only presence, red styling, badge and strikethrough are asserted; no coordinate check.

open_questions.question: Is a separate Version History button the intended entry to the visual diff, or a YAML/Visual toggle?

source_says.quote: separate entry points rather than a toggle
when the user switches to Visual mode
source_says.where: TP1-14482 parent AC2; mockup has a YAML/Visual toggle

readings.reading: Separate toolbar button on the visual editor (as built).
readings.if_chosen: The entry-point case clicks the toolbar Version History button.
The entry-point case is held as a defect and the toggle case stays manual.

open_questions.question: Is the aria-label rename on the YAML panel history button intended?

source_says.quote: looks for the old label in the YAML panel

readings.reading: Intended; the old label now belongs to the toolbar button and the existing UI test is retargeted.
readings.if_chosen: The existing test is extended to the toolbar button; a YAML-panel case uses the new label.
A bug proposal is written and the existing test is kept as the oracle.

open_questions.question: Does restoring a revision ever persist to the backend before Save?

source_says.quote: Restore validation does not persist workflow changes to the backend.
final design restores via backend rollback API
source_says.where: TP1-8827 spec-4/5 (UF-4, inspected by structure only)

readings.reading: Restore only replaces the editor YAML; nothing is stored until Save.
readings.if_chosen: The no-persist case reloads the workflow and asserts the stored config and history are unchanged.

readings.reading: Restore is a backend rollback that stores a new revision.
readings.if_chosen: AC12 is read as validation-only; a stored-revision case is added and the no-persist assertion is limited to the validate call.

open_questions.question: Does GuardrailService dry_run also skip deleting stale guardrail assignments?

source_says.quote: if dry_run: return placed before Step 6 (create new assignments)
source_says.where: testproject1!4214 guardrail_service.py:284; the delete step location was not shown in the hunk

readings.reading: Both create and delete are skipped on dry run.
readings.if_chosen: A before/after assignments check on validate is written as a no-write proof.

readings.reading: Deletes of stale assignments run before the return.
readings.if_chosen: A data-loss APP_BUG proposal is written against POST /validate.
